mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS joined, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR020' AND NOT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lost, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' THEN R.SCSBD_AMT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount, AVG(CASE WHEN R.PBANC_SN IS NOT NULL AND NOT THEN R.TECH_EVL_SCR END) AS avgTech
FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_BID_RSLT R ON R.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN
mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT TO_CHAR(TEAM_SN) AS code, TEAM_NM AS name FROM TB_TEAM WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEPT_CD = 'DP030' ORDER BY TEAM_SN

SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE AND P.BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') AS label,
WHERE AND P.BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT TM.TEAM_NM AS label,
JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE
GROUP BY TM.TEAM_SN, TM.TEAM_NM ORDER BY TM.TEAM_SN

SELECT NVL(C.CD_NM, '미지정') AS label,
LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'BZTYP' AND C.CD = P.BIZ_TYPE_CD WHERE
GROUP BY NVL(C.CD_NM, '미지정') ORDER BY 1

SELECT NVL(C.CD_NM, '미지정') AS label,
LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PTFRM' AND C.CD = P.PTCP_SHP_CD WHERE
GROUP BY NVL(C.CD_NM, '미지정') ORDER BY 1

SELECT X.artclNm AS artclNm, ROUND(AVG(X.ratio) * 100, 1) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT A.EVL_ARTCL_NM AS artclNm, AVG(S.EVL_SCR) / NULLIF(A.EVL_SCOR_SCR, 0) AS ratio FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN TB_BID_RSLT R ON R.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN JOIN TB_CO_EVL_RSLT C ON C.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND C.OUR_CO_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S ON S.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = C.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN JOIN TB_EVL_ARTCL A ON A.EVL_ARTCL_SN = S.EVL_ARTCL_SN WHERE AND NOT
GROUP BY P.PBANC_SN, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM, A.EVL_SCOR_SCR ) X WHERE X.ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY X.artclNm ORDER BY rate, X.artclNm

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS budget, CASE WHEN THEN '유찰' WHEN R.PBANC_SN IS NULL THEN '결과 대기' ELSE NVL(RC.CD_NM, '-') END AS resultNm, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS keptYn, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ddlnText FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_BID_RSLT R ON R.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD RC ON RC.GROUP_CD = 'BDRST' AND RC.CD = R.BID_RSLT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE
ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT DESC, P.PBANC_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
